top_choice_rationale: P001 recognizes a fundamental endocrine discovery with decades of mechanistic maturation and broad, sustained therapeutic transformation in diabetes and obesity. Holst, Mojsov, and Drucker form a coherent discovery-centered allocation when the citation is limited to GLP-1 physiology and therapeutic enablement rather than subsequent development of individual medicines.
